Database: robot
Task ID: robot_7

User Query:
Analyze robot operation efficiency type, where for each robot, show its ID, model series, OCE value, TPC value, average cycle time, number of unique programs, operation time, and efficiency category. Also, show each robot's efficiency ranking within its model series. Only include robots with large program cycles. Show the best ones.

You have a budget of 22.0 bird-coins. Use your tools to explore the database, clarify ambiguities with the user, and submit your final SQL efficiently.
